source.raw_prompt: Narrow live-invocation check of the Architect's direct Obsidian MCP tools.

objective: Prove whether the Architect subagent can actually invoke its own mcp__obsidian__search_notes tool at runtime (native MCP wiring check only -- no repository code claim is being investigated).
constraints: Call mcp__obsidian__search_notes exactly once with query "pagination design decisions", regardless of whether it succeeds, and echo the result as an obsidian_reads entry.
Do not investigate any other claim; produce exactly one 'found' finding stating whether the tool call itself executed (any status) or was unavailable as a named tool.

acceptance_criteria.description: The obsidian_reads array (or its genuine absence) is reported honestly.

task_graph.description: Attempt one direct Obsidian MCP call
